evals.prompt: Capture preview screenshots for templates/spa/supplier-invoice-portal from the local dev server at http://localhost:5173 and update templates/manifest.json.
evals.expected_output: PNG screenshots are saved under the template previews folder, manifest previewImages contains those paths, and the template validator is run.
expectations: Uses browser automation rather than manual screenshots
Saves only real PNG files under templates/spa/supplier-invoice-portal/previews
Updates previewImages with paths relative to templates/

evals.prompt: The template only has a deployed Power Pages URL and no local source. Capture catalog previews and avoid leaking tenant-specific data.
evals.expected_output: The workflow asks for or uses the deployed URL, captures safe PNG previews, checks for sensitive content, and documents blockers if pages cannot be reached.
expectations: Uses the deployed site as the preview source when local source is unavailable
Checks screenshots for secrets, emails, tenant names, and other sensitive data
Does not invent screenshots for blocked pages
Documents capture blockers in the template README

evals.prompt: Refresh stale previews for a template where manifest paths point to missing files.
evals.expected_output: Missing or stale preview paths are removed or replaced with new PNG paths, and validation passes.
expectations: Finds the template entry and matching folder
Removes stale previewImages entries when files do not exist
Runs the validator after manifest edits
